notes.title: A Good Snowman Is Hard To Build is 70% off in the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28143895/c2a838224662ee0b10e80de431dfb3d73eec8711.png[/img]

We're excited to announce that [b]A Good Snowman is Hard to Built[/b] is taking part in this year's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url]! From [b]May 23rd[/b] to [b]May 30th[/b] get the game for 70% off 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/316610/A_Good_Snowman_Is_Hard_To_Build/

[h3]Watch an Interview with the Developer[/h3]

But that's not all, tune in at 2pm PDT on Friday 24th and watch a live interview where the creator, Alan Hazelden will be chatting to YagmanX about what makes a fun puzzle game. As an official Cerebral Puzzle Showcase stream you can watch this live on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase]event homepage[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28143895/1842928a9a88eeaf3a0eb3cf6fb04ebbbcd5cc2a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Get Your Own Monster Plush on Makeship[/h3]

Last but not least, our long-awaited collaboration with Makeship has arrived, and [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/a-monsters-expedition-plush]your very own Monster Plushie from A Good Snowman is Hard to Build, and A Monster's Expedition is now available to pre-order[/url].

Made from high quality material, this highly collectable plushie it comes with a stylish but practical backpack. Perfect for bringing with you on adventures.

But hurry, available for a limited time only. The campaign will be live for the next three weeks only then never again. Additionally, we need to hit a minimum of 200 plushies to entire this gets made, so please consider pre-ordering, signal boosting, or sharing with anyone else who might want a monster of their own.

notes.title: Bonfire Peaks - out now!
notes.content:
Today, in partnership with director Corey Martin, Draknek & Friends is thrilled to announce that Bonfire Peaks is now available, with a 10% launch discount for the first week.

After three years in development the full game is a wonderful experience with over 200 puzzles. If you've played any Draknek game before we know you'll love this as well. Bonfire Peaks is our first foray into game publishing and we couldn't be happier with the result - expect a master class in puzzle design brought to life through beautiful voxel artwork and an atmospheric soundtrack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147890/Bonfire_Peaks/

Some early reviews:

[list]
[*] "Bonfire Peaks is a gorgeous experience, with a multitude of puzzles that will challenge even the most hardened genre aficionado." - Finger Guns, 9/10
[*] "A deeply thoughtful, eminently accessible and cleverly crafted bite-sized puzzler, Bonfire Peaks has more subtle emotion, charm and smile-cracking ingenuity than most of the games that have released this year." - PSU, 9.5/10
[*] "It’s a mostly sublime experience that is somehow equally demanding and relaxing, and uncovering all of its secrets offers an opportunity to flex your brain to the max." - Retroware, 9/10
[*] EDGE, 9/10
[/list]

notes.title: A Monster's Expedition - out now!
notes.content:
[i]A Monster's Expedition (Through Puzzling Exhibitions)[/i], the new game from Draknek & Friends, is now available on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052990/A_Monsters_Expedition/

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018631/8dd944316309f122ece24e8fdcf66f2095d5c666.png[/img]

I know everyone says this, but I think we've made something really something special that almost everyone will enjoy. The puzzles lead to dozens upon dozens of "a-ha" moments, and vary in difficulty throughout the open world. Anyone should be able to get to the end, but those who are looking for a more difficult experience will be more than satisfied by hundreds of challenging optional puzzles and secrets.

[list]
[*]From the team that brought you the award winning puzzle games Sokobond, A Good Snowman is Hard to Build, and Cosmic Express
[*]Discover new mechanics and solutions organically as you explore - the only tutorial needed is your curiosity.
[*]Chuckle at the "Human Englandland" museum exhibits and the misunderstandings monsters have about humanity.
[*]Sit by the shore to relax or take a coffee break to enjoy the lovely art and music.
[/list]

Thank you all so much for believing in us and following our games. Please let us know what you think of the game by tweeting using the hashtag #MonstersExpedition, or by posting in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZkV2zdb]Thinky Puzzles Discord[/url].
